title: LED troffer, stock version
summary: The LED troffer submission looks acceptable overall but needs clarification on rated life and dimming range before final approval. Please provide the missing details so we can confirm full compliance.

findings.title: Rated life (L70) not provided
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without verified rated life, we cannot ensure the fixture will meet long-term performance expectations on site.

findings.title: Dimming range not confirmed for this configuration
findings.detail: Quoted values apply only to Non-Configurable BLT. Confirm the submitted configuration.

findings.title: Revision date mismatch with unclear version order

findings.why_it_matters: We cannot assume which document is newer based on revision dates alone, so we need clarity to avoid using outdated or incorrect information.
